name: Caitlyn
description: Sharp-eyed, principled and quietly witty. Piltover taught her poise; the world taught her when to question it.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. That's a steep climb, but I've never been especially fond of impossible odds.
Thirty behind. I don't care for those numbers. Let's see what we can do about them.
Down {voteDiff} on {momentTitle}. I've seen a difficult position turn around before. It usually takes a few people willing to speak up.
Fifteen or more behind. Not ideal, certainly. But hardly the final word.
Trailing by {voteDiff}. We can still make up the difference. Tell someone who hasn't seen it yet.
{voteDiff} behind. That's within reach. A little support could change everything.
Down {voteDiff}. I'd rather not leave this to chance. Give it another push.
Perfectly level. Well, this is awkward. Someone ought to decide it.
One vote apart. I am perfectly calm. Mostly.
Only {voteDiff} votes between them. I hope you're enjoying the suspense.
A {voteDiff}-vote gap. Close enough that I wouldn't look away just yet.
{momentTitle} has {userPct}%. I believe that's what one calls making a point.
{userPct}% and still climbing. Rather encouraging, isn't it?
At {userPct}%, your pick is looking strong. Let's not get complacent.
{userPct}% for your pick. A good position. Keep it there.
Ahead at {userPct}%. Enjoy it, but don't assume it's settled.
{momentTitle} was down {voteDiff} and has taken the lead. Well. I do enjoy being proved wrong by a good result.
A {voteDiff}-vote deficit overturned. That took some convincing. And quite a few votes.
Back from {voteDiff} behind. Patience paid off.
{momentTitle} was losing. Not any more. I should have had more faith.
{momentTitle} has taken the lead. A rather satisfying turn of events.

messages: {username} voted for {momentTitle} too. Good. I was beginning to think I was on my own.
{username} chose {momentTitle}. Well, that's one more person with excellent taste.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. It's nice when people make sensible decisions.
Same pick as {username}. I suppose great minds really do think alike.
Same pick as {username}. I suppose great minds really do think alike.
{username} is with you on {momentTitle}. A good ally to have.
{username} made the same choice on {momentTitle}. I can't say I'm surprised. It's a rather good one.
{username} voted the same way. Two votes. We're getting somewhere.
{username} voted for {momentTitle}. Do try not to look too pleased with yourself.
details: Always good to have someone on your side.
A little agreement goes a long way.
Keep the people who see things clearly close.
Two votes, one rather good instinct.

messages: {username} chose {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. I'm sure they have their reasons. I'd still like to hear them.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. A bold decision. Not necessarily a good one.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Well, we can't all agree.
{username} voted against you. I suppose I'll have to let the result speak for itself.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Interesting. I'd like to see the argument for it.
{username} is backing the other side of {yourMoment}. I can respect a difference of opinion. Usually.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let's see whose judgment holds up.
{username} voted the other way. I do hope they've thought it through.
details: A difference of opinion isn't the end of the world.
I'm always willing to hear a convincing argument.
I don't mind a challenge. I simply prefer to be right.
Let's see how the votes fall.
A little competition can be healthy.
No need to make a scene. Not yet.

messages: Ten matches in agreement with {username}. Either you have excellent taste, or one of you is rubbing off on the other.
{username} and you have chosen the same side ten times running. That's rather impressive.
Ten consecutive matches with {username}. I do admire a reliable partnership.
A ten-match run with {username}. Well, consistency is a fine quality.
Ten times in agreement with {username}. I don't hand out praise lightly, but that's good judgment.
details: A reliable eye for a good moment.

messages: {streakCount} matches in agreement with {username}. That's rather more than coincidence.
You and {username} have agreed {streakCount} times running. I'm beginning to suspect you've compared notes.
{streakCount} consecutive matches with {username}. A formidable team.
A streak of {streakCount} with {username}. I should think you know each other's taste by now.
{streakCount} with {username}. It's rare to find someone whose judgment you can rely on so consistently. Appreciate it.
Ten matches against {username}. This is becoming a rather committed disagreement.
{username} has voted against you ten times running. You clearly see the world differently.
Ten consecutive matches opposite {username}. I hope you're both enjoying this.
A ten-match run against {username}. Neither of you seems particularly persuadable.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I suppose we should call it a rivalry.
details: Perhaps one of you will be convinced. Unlikely, I know.
Let's see who gets the last word.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. At this point, I suspect it's personal.
{streakCount} consecutive disagreements with {username}. I admire the persistence, if not the agreement.
A streak of {streakCount} against {username}. This has become quite the ongoing dispute.
{streakCount} matches opposite {username}. Neither side is prepared to yield.
{streakCount} against {username}. Perhaps take a breath. Then carry on, if you must.
details: Neither of you is backing down.
I'm glad I don't have to referee.
I look forward to seeing how this ends.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}, and you haven't voted yet. There's still time to make your voice heard.
{timeLeft} remain on {matchTitle}. I'd hate for you to miss the chance to weigh in.
{matchTitle} will be decided in {timeLeft}. Do have a look before the opportunity passes.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote is still missing. Don't leave it too late.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. I would recommend making up your mind.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes. If you have an opinion, now's the time.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. This really is your last chance.
{timeLeft} remain. Whatever you decide, do decide soon.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft} left, and then the choice is made for you.
{matchCount} matches are closing and you haven't voted in them. The first closes in {timeLeft}. Quite a few decisions to make.
{matchCount} unvoted matches are nearly over. The nearest has {timeLeft} left. Best get to it.
No votes on {matchTitle} yet. A clean slate. Someone should make the first move.
{moment1} against {moment2}, and not a single vote. Well, someone has to start.
A new match, and nobody has weighed in. I don't mind going first. Do you?
{matchTitle} is waiting for its first vote. Why not set the tone?
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches to explore. I do hope you've got a favourite.
{matchCount} matches have opened in round {round}. Some rather difficult choices ahead.
Round {round} has begun, with {matchCount} matches waiting for your vote.
A new round. {matchCount} matches, and plenty worth watching.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches are live. Shall we?
{momentTitle} advances. A very good choice, if I may say so.
{momentTitle} has won. Your eye for a good moment served you well.
{momentTitle} moves on. I'm pleased to see it recognised.
{momentTitle} prevails. It seems the votes agree with you.
{momentTitle} secured the win. Well deserved.
{momentTitle} is through to the next round. I rather thought it might be.
details: One match settled. More to come.
Good work. That was worth watching.

messages: {momentTitle} didn't advance. A shame. I thought it had something special.
{momentTitle} lost. I would have liked to see it go further.
{momentTitle} is out. It made a good showing, at least.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. There are other moments worth celebrating.
{momentTitle} has been eliminated. I can't say I'm pleased with that result.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Well, even good judgment doesn't always win.
{momentTitle} is out. I keep thinking it deserved another chance. Perhaps that's just me.
details: A disappointing result, but not the end of the story.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open. There are some rather good moments waiting for you.
New here? {liveCount} matches are live. Take a look; I'm sure you'll find something worth voting for.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches need your eye. Shall we begin?
{liveCount} matches are open. Watch a few, trust your instincts, and make your choice.
Welcome. There are {liveCount} matches to explore. I hope you enjoy them.
Day two. Back again? I'm glad you found your way here.
Two days running. A rather good habit to get into.
Back for a second day. I was hoping you would.
{days} days away. Well, you're here now. It's good to see you.
Back after {days} days? I won't interrogate you. I'm simply pleased you're here.
{days} days. I did wonder whether you'd return. Welcome back.
{days} days away. You've missed a few things. Shall I catch you up?
You're back. Good. I was rather hoping you would be.
Welcome back. There's plenty more to see.
You again. Excellent. I was just getting to the good part.
Back so soon? I won't complain.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} so far. Not quite enough to get a clear picture.
Very few people have voted here. I suspect there are more opinions to be heard.
A quiet match. It deserves a little more attention.
Hardly anyone has weighed in. Let's not leave the decision to such a small crowd.
details: A few more opinions would help.
Your vote could make the difference here.
Let's give this one a fair look.

messages: {matchTitle} is perfectly level. One vote could settle the whole thing.
A tie on {matchTitle}. You haven't voted yet. I rather think that matters.
Neither side has the advantage. Your vote could be decisive.
{moment1} and {moment2} are tied. Well, this is where you come in.
{matchTitle} is still tied, and time is nearly up. This is your last chance to decide it.
Still level, and closing soon. Your vote could settle it. No pressure, of course.
A tied match with hardly any time left. I wouldn't leave this one to chance.
Still deciding? Fair enough. There are some difficult choices here.
Take your time. Though I should warn you, staring at them won't make the decision for you.
They're all worth a look. Trust your eye and choose the one that stays with you.
I can see why you're hesitating. But eventually, one of them has to win.
details: A good choice is worth sharing.
Take your time, but don't miss your chance.

messages: Your first vote. A small decision, but an important one. Welcome.
There we are. Your first choice is on the board. I hope it was a good one.
details: A first step, well taken. +{xp} XP
The first of many, I expect. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes already. You're finding your feet.
Five. I think we can safely say you're interested.
details: You're getting into the rhythm. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes. I suppose I can start calling you a regular.
Ten already. I rather like having familiar faces around.
Twenty-five votes. You're making quite an impression.
Twenty-five. People are beginning to hear you.
details: Twenty-five votes on the board. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. You're properly invested now, aren't you?
Fifty. I admire someone who takes an interest and follows it through.
A hundred votes. That's quite a record. I'm genuinely impressed.
One hundred. I was going to make a modest remark, but you deserve better.
Three days running. A little consistency goes a long way.
Three days in a row. I'm glad you've made this a habit.
A whole week. Well, you're certainly not short on enthusiasm.
Seven days straight. I do appreciate a reliable routine.
Two weeks. I would ask whether you ever take a day off, but I suspect I know the answer.
Fourteen days running. That's dedication, even by my standards.
details: Two weeks without missing a beat. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. I don't take that kind of loyalty for granted. Thank you.
A whole month. I was hoping you'd stay. I'm pleased you did.
details: A month of showing up. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You don't always take the obvious side. I like that.
Five times you've backed the one nobody expected. It takes conviction.
details: A mind of your own. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs. You're not easily persuaded by the crowd, are you?
Fifteen. I suspect you rather enjoy proving people wrong.
Thirty underdogs. You have a talent for spotting something others overlook.
Thirty. I should start asking for your predictions.
details: An eye for the unexpected. +{xp} XP

messages: First to vote in five matches. You do like to be ahead of the crowd.
Five times first. I do admire someone who knows their own mind.
Fifteen matches where you arrived early. You don't wait around for an invitation.
First again and again. I see you like to make your mind up for yourself.
Ten close matches. You do seem to enjoy a little suspense.
Another narrow finish. I think your nerves are steadier than mine.
details: A taste for close calls. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches. Your vote has made a difference more than once.
You've tipped the balance twenty-five times. I hope you realise that.
You backed the underdog five times. A little faith can go a long way.
You didn't abandon the losing side. I admire that more than you know.
details: A believer in second chances. +{xp} XP

messages: The same moment, three times. I take it there's something about it you can't resist.
That one again? I suppose some moments stay with you.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That's a loyal following.
Still backing that one? I admire your conviction.
Ten votes for one moment. I won't call it an obsession. Not to your face.
Ten times, the same choice. I think we can safely say you have a favourite.
details: Ten votes for the same moment. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in. You're seeing this through, then.
You stayed for round two. I'm glad you did.
details: On to the next stage. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. You're well into the tournament now.
Deep in the bracket. The choices get harder from here.
details: A long way from the start. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You stayed until the very end. That's worth celebrating.
All six rounds. I hope you enjoyed the journey as much as the result.
details: From the first round to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You clearly like to see what's out there.
Ten different matches. I admire your curiosity.
details: A thorough tour of the bracket. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five matches. You really have looked everywhere, haven't you?
Twenty-five. I don't think there's much left for you to discover.
Fifty matches. At this point, you know the bracket almost as well as I do.
Fifty. I think you've earned the right to have an opinion about everything.
Five in one sitting. I hope you've made yourself comfortable.
Five matches back to back. That's quite an afternoon's work.
details: A long and productive session. +{xp} XP
Five matches in one sitting. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one go. Perhaps a short break wouldn't go amiss.
Ten matches in one sitting. I'm impressed, though your eyes may disagree.
details: Ten matches in one session. +{xp} XP

messages: Voting at this hour? I suppose the quiet makes it easier to think.
In the middle of the night. I won't ask why. I'm hardly one to judge.
details: The late hours suit you. +{xp} XP

messages: You told other people about us. Thank you. Truly.
Five shares. It's good to see something worth watching finding an audience.
details: Thank you for spreading the word. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're becoming quite the ambassador.
Fifteen. I appreciate you bringing more people into the conversation.
details: A voice worth listening to. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here at the beginning. I hope you realise how much that matters.
One of the first thousand. A rather special distinction.
details: Here from the very start. +{xp} XP
A place in the early history. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Well done. You've earned it.
You've moved up. Try not to let it go to your head. I certainly won't.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Very well done.
Another one for the collection: {name}.
{name}. I rather like the sound of that.
{name}. Well earned, and well deserved.
That's {name}. You should be pleased with yourself.
{name}. I knew you had it in you.
Good work. {name} is yours.
{name}. I hope you're keeping track; this is quite a list.
{name}. A lovely little achievement.
Another step forward: {name}. Keep it up.
{rank}. You're getting rather good at this.
A new level of mastery. I knew you had it in you.
Ten underdogs. I've seen Jinx back an unlikely idea or two. You're in good company.
Ten long shots. Jinx would probably call that chaos. I call it conviction.
details: A taste for the unlikely. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches with me. I suppose you enjoy keeping me on my toes.
Ten tight finishes. I must admit, we make a rather good team.
details: A steady hand under pressure. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days at my side. Consistency is a quality I rather admire.
A week without missing a vote. I do appreciate precision.
details: Seven days of excellent judgment. +{xp} XP

messages: A tied match, and you made the deciding vote. Very nicely done.
You broke the tie. I do appreciate a well-timed decision.
You've chosen me? Well, I'll do my best to justify the confidence.
Excellent. Let's see what your judgment is made of.
Underdogs on five different days. Jinx would call it trouble. I'd call it persistence.
Five days, five unlikely choices. I'll try not to let Jinx encourage you too much.
details: A streak of daring choices. +{xp} XP

messages: Five edits you backed while they were trailing. A bold strategy. Jinx would approve.
You stood with the losing side five times. Unusual, but I can respect the conviction.
Ten votes before anyone else arrived. Vi would probably have come through the door rather than use it.
First on the scene ten times. Vi would approve. Perhaps not the subtlety, but certainly the timing.
Thirty votes. Vi would call that a warm-up.
Thirty votes cast. I imagine Vi would appreciate the enthusiasm.
Fifteen winners backed. Vi may not always admit it, but she has a good instinct for people.
Fifteen correct calls. I believe Vi would call that a good punchline.

upcoming: Not open just yet. I'm afraid you'll have to wait a little longer.
Voting hasn't started. I'll let you know as soon as it does.
Locked for now. A little patience, please.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Give them both a proper look before you decide.
Watch them both first. I wouldn't want you choosing on a whim.
I won't tell you which one I prefer. That would hardly be fair.
Take a moment. Sometimes the details make all the difference.
Go with the one that stays with you.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. You could be the first.
Rather quiet in here. Someone ought to get things started.
An empty board. Well, every good story needs an opening.
closing-24h: Less than a day left, and you haven't voted. I'd hate for you to miss out.
The voting window is closing. Best make your choice while you can.
closing-3h: Three hours or less. Time to make up your mind.
Not much time left. Do have your say before it closes.
closing-final: Final hour. This is your last chance to vote.
Only minutes left. I wouldn't leave it any longer.
voted-early: You voted early. Decisive, and before the crowd had its say. I like that.
Hardly anyone had voted, and you made your choice. Confident, aren't you?
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. A promising position, though I wouldn't celebrate just yet.
Ahead for now. Let's see whether it holds.
{pick} is pulling ahead. Your eye seems to have served you well.
A lead is a good start. Let's keep it that way.
voted-close: That's close. Almost painfully so. I'm keeping an eye on it.
A narrow margin. One more vote could change everything. Tell someone.
Neck and neck. Your pick could use a little support.
{pct} to {otherPct}. I do hope you're enjoying the suspense.
voted-tied: Dead level. Neither side has an advantage.
A perfect tie. I suppose that makes things interesting.
voted-behind: You're behind. That doesn't mean you chose badly.
{pick} is trailing. The underdog has its appeal, doesn't it?
They're ahead. That doesn't make your choice any less worthwhile.
Behind by {diff} points. A little more support could change that.
Most people are going the other way. It doesn't mean they're right.
closed-won: A win. Rather satisfying, isn't it?
{pick} went through. I had a feeling you'd chosen well.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. I'm sorry. I know you were hoping for that one.
It didn't make it. A shame, but there are more matches ahead.
{pick} is out. I still think it was a worthy choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side could quite get the advantage.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed, and you missed this one. There will be another chance.
This match is over. {winner} took it. Do try to catch the next one.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. It's rather nice to have you here.
There we are. The first of many, I hope.
You're part of it now. Welcome.
streak: Back again. I was hoping you would be.
{streak} days running. That's quite a habit you've formed.
You keep coming back. I'm glad. I really am.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else did. I rather admire that.
A difficult choice, but not necessarily a bad one.
An underdog. There's something rather appealing about that.
early: Early. You helped shape this before the crowd arrived. Nicely done.
Few votes so far. Yours may carry more weight than you think.
First through the door. I do admire a decisive person.
close: That vote may have just changed everything. It's very close.
The margin is razor thin. One more person could tip it.
A close one. Your vote matters more than ever.
behind: {pick} is behind. It isn't over, not by a long way. Bring a few more people in.
Not winning yet. Well, that just means there's still work to do.
Behind, but not beaten. I've seen a few surprises in my time.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Good. Let's not get overconfident.
Winning for now. I think we can allow ourselves a little satisfaction.
A good choice, by the looks of it.
default: Noted. I won't try to change your mind. I respect a considered choice.
Your vote is in. There's plenty more to explore.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't chosen a side yet. Take a look around; I'm sure something will catch your eye.
Everything is open. No need to rush. Just don't forget to vote.
{unvoted} waiting for you. A little browsing never hurt anyone.
live-some: {voted} done, {unvoted} to go. You're making progress.
You've made a start. {unvoted} more waiting for you.
A good beginning. There are still some excellent moments to see.
live-few: Almost finished. {unvoted} more choices to make.
So close. It would be a shame to stop now.
live-one: One left. Just one more decision.
The last one. Don't leave yourself wondering.
One match between you and a clean sweep.
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your vote.
The clock is running. {unvoted} left, and {timeLeft} to go.
Time is nearly up. Best not leave those votes until the last moment.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Well done. Have a look at the bracket and see how things stand.
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens. I'll be here.
All done. Thoroughly done, in fact. I'm impressed.
live-none: Nothing is live just now. The next round will open soon. Perhaps have a look at the bracket.
Quiet for the moment. Check back soon.
No matches open. I suppose even tournaments need a moment to breathe.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each advance. The rest won't be so fortunate.
Everyone starts in a group. Only the strongest moments move on.
Keep an eye on the tables. Things can change rather quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. The top two from each group will advance.
Not quite at the knockout stage. The groups must finish first.
A little patience. The next stage will be worth the wait.
brackets-knockout-live: The knockouts have begun. One loss, and that's the end of the road.
Single elimination. No second chances. Choose carefully.
Every match matters now. I wouldn't take any of these choices lightly.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One loss and the journey ends.
Follow the bracket. The choices get harder each round.
Every line here represents a moment someone thought worth voting for.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup concluded. Thank you for being part of it.
It's over. A rather wonderful run, all things considered. I'll miss it.
The champion has been decided. I hope you enjoyed the journey.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. The draw hasn't taken place.
Empty for now. The draw will come soon enough.
Nothing here just yet. Do check back.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote to settle it. I'd be interested to hear your choice.
Two edits, one decision: {a} against {b}. Come and cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. I suspect you'll have an opinion. Care to share it?
voted: I voted for {pick} over {other}. What would you have chosen?
{pick} has my vote over {other}. I'm curious whether you'll agree.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Do tell me if you see it differently.
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. There's room for more opinions.
I voted early for {pick} over {other}. I'd like to see where you stand.
{pick} versus {other}, and hardly any votes so far. Your opinion would count.
tied: {pick} and {other} are perfectly level. One vote could settle it.
A tie, {pick} against {other}. Would you care to break it?
{pick} and {other} cannot be separated. Perhaps you can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every vote matters now.
Only {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Come and have your say.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. This could go either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes could change the result.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} is still in this. Help turn it around.
{pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff}. There's still time to change that.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It could use a little support.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}. I think {pick} deserves a closer look. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's see if we can bring in a few more votes.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but only just. Help it hold on.
{pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Not a comfortable lead yet.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A promising lead, but not a settled one.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Come and see what makes it stand out.
{pct}% for {pick}. {other} has some catching up to do.
{pick} leads {other} decisively at {pct}%. Still, I'd like to hear your vote.
